title: Hover Rancher Soundtrack
description: The downloadable Hover Rancher soundtrack, available on Steam. The base game is not included.

title: Hover Rancher
description: Pilot your hovercraft across a wild, untamed world in Hover Rancher—a point-and-click adventure packed with action minigames like aerial dogfights and snowboarding! Explore, collect, and deploy troops as you build your ranching empire from the skies.

title: Squirrel Idle Tycoon
description: Squirrel Idle Tycoon is a cozy, addictive idle game where you grow a squirrel-powered ice and water business into a thriving empire. Gather resources, hire hardworking squirrels, unlock powerful upgrades, and earn passive income even while you’re offline.

title: Emu Empire
description: Build your empire, manage resources, and ascend to greatness in Emu Empire—a quirky strategy game where every decision shapes your legacy!

title: Dillingham
description: Dillingham is a fast-paced fish-processing and logistics simulator where chaos meets precision. Run an Alaskan seafood plant, unload boats, sort and process fish, manage conveyor systems, operate forklifts, and keep every station flowing before the whole line backs up.

title: Goat Nuclear Clicker
description: An absurd incremental clicker — click goats, trigger nuclear chaos, automate production, and ascend through galaxies in a multiverse of upgrades and detonation-driven mayhem.
